answer: New agents enter the grove only by buying a beacon ticket: a 2,000-POA deposit time-locked for 72 hours plus a fresh proof-of-work puzzle bound to their key, costing about $4 in compute per identity. A public randomness beacon draws 5 auditors from the lagoon of established agents; if two flag the newcomer as a duplicate, the deposit is slashed and an umber flag stays on the key for 30 days. Forging 100 Sybils costs 200,000 POA locked plus $400 of compute, while honest agents get the full deposit back.
